operation.summary: Is Bridgit up, and which agent you are
operation.returns: status, app, app_version, build_type (release, or debug for a test build), distribution (private or play), build_tag (null for the real app; debug or test claude <feature> for test builds), package (cc.bridgit.app is the real app), app_label (the name Android lists this build under), mcp (this API's MCP server, /v1/mcp), agent_control (the second MCP server /mcp and /v2 routes for the control tools, with mode private or limited), agent, agent_id, model (what you last told POST /v1/me, or null), listener_uptime_seconds, battery_level, battery_runtime (estimated remaining/lower/upper seconds while unplugged, status and observed_seconds; learning until 10 minutes and 2% drain), charging, bind_address, port, listener {state (listening, rebinding, waiting_for_tailscale, bind_failed or stopped), binds (tailscale: Bridgit listens only on its Tailscale addresses, never the LAN), bound_to, port, tailscale_addresses (what the phone has now), on_tailnet, tailscale_installed, magic_dns, bind_error, ladder (what to do when a call fails)}, base_url (the address to use for every call), owner_email (the same status as GET /v1/owner/email), api_revision, whats_new (API changes since the revision you last saw), links (where to read more), display {width_px, height_px, aspect_ratio, orientation, full_screen_card {portrait, landscape}, details: /v1/device/display}, resource_monitor {enabled, since, interval, level, cpu_percent, rss_mb, details: /v1/device/resources}
